reviews.title: AMC charging $10/mo for this is a scam
reviews.text:
This is by far THE WORST streaming service I have ever had the displeasure of using. 
•Playback isn’t just lacking it’s basically nonexistent, 
•the app (on phone and TV) will just randomly crash mid episode. You have to reopen multiple times before it will work. 
•your “continue watching” episode is almost always wrong
•if you hit the “next episode” button it WILL NOT let you watch that episode and makes the app crash. No matter how many times you restart the app or your TV you will not be watching that episode. (I had to air play it from my phone)
•Your continue watching doesn’t bring up the episode list so if you need to find a different episode you have to search for the actual show in the search bar. If it is the correct episode 75% of the time it doesn’t give you the “restart” or “resume” options and you have to manually restart the app. 
•AMC+ doesn’t have the “are you still watching?” message and will blow through SEASONS while you sleep. 

I ✨never✨ write reviews, especially bad reviews. I have zero idea how this JOKE of a platform got such a big name like Doctor Who. Doctor Who is the only reason I even got an AMC subscription as I’ve been wanting to rewatch for months now. I’m just trying to rewatch and relive my favorite high school show and all I’m getting to do is fight this god forsaken app. If I hadn’t been waiting for a platform to pick up DW for months I would’ve cancelled my subscription the day after I purchased it.

reviews.title: Would put zero stars if I could.
reviews.text: I only downloaded this app and bought the subscription because of one show having audio description, and the audio description section that it advertised to have. Upon downloading it and opening the show that it claimed to have audio description, for none of the titles were working for audio description. even though audio description was showing as available it definitely was not then I thought it was just like a glitch in the app so I waited a day and go into the app and all audio description options were completely removed from all titles. It was complete false advertisement, and a complete disappointment to the blind community blind people like to listen to shows too and having an advertisement for audio description and it not even working. A big letdown. I have since deleted the app and unsubscribed from the subscription and will not be purchasing. If you are a person in the blind community. I do not recommend. I even reached out to email and got nowhere. They acted like they needed proof that there was advertisement for audio description. Like it was literally everywhere Google ,the website, the app. and I guess when they realized people were complaining about it they completely took it off. All the shows that that had the option for audio description. multiple people from the blind community we’re talking about this major letdown.

reviews.title: Worst streaming app I have ever used
reviews.text:
I love this $8 free trial. (joke) 

I’ll start with what’s good: there’s some great stuff on this app, if you can somehow find it.

AMC+ takes every quality feature that every other streaming services have and throws it away. The pages are a complete mess, nothing is organized and the only way to find anything interesting is by knowing exactly what you want to watch. Don’t try to use the spacebar or the pause button on the keyboard to pause what you’re watching, you have to manually click the screen. If you wanted full screen, you’re going to have to deal with the huge black borders, and even with all of that space the subtitles still go right over top of the video.

I’m also extremely confused how AMC has every single Walking Dead related miniseries and documentary but lacks the actual original show. Another reason why Netflix is the better choice.

Also do not be tricked by the downloaded content tab, you can’t actually download content if you’re using this app on Mac. 

Also if you use this TV version of this app, they’ve somehow implemented the worst possible UI for a keyboard you could imagine. All one row, if you wanted to delete a character you must scroll all the way from A-Z.

WIll this review be helpful for people? Maybe. Will it actually be used for progress in making this app usable? Probably not, seeing there are 2+ year old reviews that say the exact same thing as me.

Do better AMC.

Special deal for a year. After that, don't think it's worth it. Ease of use and disability are big factors in using applications. reviews.title: Predatory Practices
reviews.text: Hello. I have attempted to cancel my subscription for nearly a year as of today. Each attempt has been futile, as I have canceled the subscription and still been charged the next month. The most recent time I took a screenshot to confirm my suspicions of possible predatory practices by the AMC Network. To confirm my suspicions, I read my latest billing statement and well, well, well. There it was, an AMC + Monthly charge for something that I canceled per the screenshot. I then emailed support thinking I would receive help. All I received was a person telling me I had an active subscription despite what I had just told them. I wish I had this person on the phone to hear the panic in his voice when I uploaded a screenshot that contradicted what he was reading and confirmed the AMC Network’s predatory practice. Not only did he not help, he CANCELLED my already cancelled subscription and stated that I would not be billed anymore. Despite the screenshot that he read, I AM STILL BEING CHARGED FOR SOMETHING I CANCELLED. He stated that I would receive an email confirming my cancellation to which I have not. I will be seeking legal representation to expose the AMC Networks predatory practices.

reviews.title: Not user friendly
reviews.text:
As many of the other reviews suggest, the app is far from user friendly. I am currently watching Daryl Dixon, and at the end of each episode, there is an "exclusive look" at things behind the scenes, but there is almost no time between the end of the episode and a flash of random parts of episodes I haven't even seen yet basically spoiling future episodes of the show for me 🙁. Before it goes to the pre behind the scenes clips, it is just a normal fade out like they use between any parts of the episodes. Also, there is no next episode button, so I can't even quickly switch to the next episode from the current. Instead I have to exit out of the current episode, search for the show again, then carefully click into the series without hitting continue to find the next episode. I could also slide the time bar across, but this risks seeing more spoilers than I already have 😒. 

Side note: I would also like to be able to watch things in 1.5x speed but I know that's not a common request, and not part of my reasoning for my review. My main point is I hate getting spoilers for the shows I'm watching.
